howEstablished: The running assembly wrote an activation binding (domain aukora:activation-binding:upgraded-web:v1) naming the receipt key id. The broker's owner-only key leaf supplied the public half. The two agree, so the exported key is the key the recorded activation names.
pinStrength: Local same-UID pin. It shows the signing key is the one the current activation names; it is not proof that an independent principal vouches for that key, and a reader requiring peer separation must pin the key out of band.
